n, p = map(float, input().split())
n = int(n)

def compute_choose_two(n):
    if n < 2:
        return 0
    return n * (n - 1) // 2

def compute_choose_three(n):
    if n < 3:
        return 0
    return n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) // 6

total_ways = compute_choose_three(n)

for i in range(n + 1):
    p1 = (i * compute_choose_two(n - i)) / total_ways if total_ways != 0 else 0
    p2 = (compute_choose_two(i) * (n - i)) / total_ways if total_ways != 0 else 0
    p3 = compute_choose_three(i) / total_ways if total_ways != 0 else 0
    probability = p1 / 2 + p2 + p3
    if probability >= p:
        print(i)
        break
